messages.content: Great, let's start our IEEE-style requirement gathering for your task management app. No technical knowledge is needed—just describe what you envision.

analysis_summary: We're building a task management app to help users organize and track their tasks. Let's clarify a few details to ensure we build exactly what you need.

question_plan.summary: We're building a task management app to help users organize and track their tasks. Let's clarify a few details to ensure we build exactly what you need.

questions.question: Who will be using this app most often?
What are the most important things people should be able to do in the app?
questions.placeholder: e.g., create tasks, set due dates, mark tasks as complete, organize tasks into lists

questions.question: Where do you want people to use this app first?
How should users sign in to access their tasks?
What kind of reminders or updates should the app send to users?
questions.placeholder: e.g., task due date reminders, daily summary of pending tasks

questions.question: Are there any privacy or data protection rules this app needs to follow?
Roughly how many users do you expect to have when the app launches?
Does it need to connect with any other tools or services?
questions.placeholder: Example: payment service, email, SMS, calendar, WhatsApp, ERP.

introduction.purpose: This document defines the functional and non-functional requirements for Untitled App.

product_scope.summary: We're building a task management app to help users organize and track their tasks. Let's clarify a few details to ensure we build exactly what you need.
benefits: Transforms guided interview answers into a structured IEEE SRS
goals: Deliver the first usable release of Untitled App.
Support JSON and PDF artifact export

product_perspective.system_context: Untitled App is delivered through web browser with an API layer, AI orchestration, persistent storage, and downloadable artifacts.

performance_requirements.description: The system shall return primary page loads and standard API actions within 2 seconds under normal load.

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: The system shall protect uploaded materials, generated artifacts, and session metadata.
authorization_requirements: Role-based access to projects and exports

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: The platform only marks an SRS ready when required sections have content and export artifacts can be produced.

database_requirements.description: The database shall store sessions, answers, upload metadata, generated SRS JSON, and validation results.
database_requirements.retention_policy: Retain project data until policy-based cleanup

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The platform shall state how uploaded materials are stored and used for generation.

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: Recommended delivery stack: Next.js 15 + Tailwind CSS with FastAPI REST API and Python AI worker with LangGraph-compatible orchestration.
